name: Temporal Reprojection for Linear Models
definition: A technique to exploit temporal coherence by reprojecting linear models (coefficients and features) rather than just pixel colors, allowing the model to react immediately to abrupt changes in camera, light, or transfer functions.
summary: Temporal Reprojection for Linear Models denoises volume rendering by reprojecting linear model coefficients instead of pixel colors, enabling immediate reaction to abrupt lighting changes without Monte Carlo integration resets.
